name: Discount-aware free gift settings
description: Configure a gift-line discount that counts the gift toward minimum spend
title: Discount-aware free gift
helpText: Gift lines are identified by a matching line item property. Every product line counts toward the minimum, including the gift. The discount is that gift line's price and applies only to the gift. Add _hoodie_bundle_exclude on the gift line so the hoodie bundle does not pair it, and allow this discount to combine with product discounts.
linePropertyRequired: Line item property key is required
minSpendInvalid: Minimum spend must be zero or greater
redemptionsOneNote: Customers get one free gift when the cart reaches the minimum spend.
redemptionsMultipleNote: Customers get one free gift for each multiple of the minimum spend.
bundleExcludeNote: The gift line also needs the _hoodie_bundle_exclude line item property so the hoodie bundle discount skips it.
